source: authored in Word 16 for the in-place rewrite test corpus (d_picture)
exercises: an inline picture alone in a paragraph and one inside a sentence, a caption with a SEQ field, a text box anchored to a paragraph
blocks: The photograph below was taken from the north pier at low tide.
Figure 1: The inner harbour at low tide
Each survey sheet carries a small marker  like this one beside the grid reference.
The side note alongside this paragraph records who carried out the survey.
Further photographs are held in the project archive.
